item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 31/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The tropical cyclone over the northern part of the South China Sea will make landfall over the coast of western Guangdong later today to early morning tomorrow and move inland. Under the influence of the associated broad areas of rain, it will be windy with squally heavy showers and thunderstorms over the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary today and tomorrow. With the tropical cyclone weaken inland, showers will ease off gradually over the region early next week. A strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 01/06 (Saturday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4 to 5, force 6 at first, up to force 7 on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with squally showers and a few thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. There will be swells.
Temp range: 26 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
